title: A reader can read TheHallucinator.ai in Spanish, with the satire label in Spanish too
description:
Ryan, 2026-11-15: TheHallucinator.ai must be bilingual, English plus Spanish (es-419), "Now it also speaks Spanish". Uses the Papyrus multilingual system (docs/multilingual-serving.md). Plan and dependencies: docs/spanish-edition/README.md. Interface strings: sites/the-hallucinator/strings/. Language overlays (data, saved with the papyrus CLI): docs/spanish-edition/. Papyrus PR 1585 makes the editions say the notice in their own language.

```gherkin
Feature: The Hallucinator speaks Spanish

  Scenario: A Spanish reader gets the edition under /es/ with a switcher and hreflang
    Given es-419 is enabled and public with the prefix es
    And a Story has a reviewed Spanish translation
    Then the Spanish page is at /es/articles/SLUG/, declares lang es-419, lists hreflang en, es and x-default, and offers a language switcher

  Scenario: The satire label survives in Spanish everywhere
    Given a published Spanish translation
    Then its page footer line, its Markdown twin, its feed entry and its structured data say the label in Spanish

  Scenario: Jokes survive translation
    Given the es-419 writing and glossary overlays are saved
    Then a translation keeps the deadpan register, the brand THE HALLUCINATOR and ChatGPT, and a person has read it before it is public
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Spanish live at https://thehallucinator.ai/es/ (build 17, Papyrus 5.125.0, 2026-11-16). Open outside this card: the visible language switcher is coming from Papyrus core; skip-link and date-format defects are reported to Papyrus.
